participation.context: Held the two lines under a finger and did not revise them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Left his hand flat beside the leaf.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

relations.note: the line, and the hand that will not leave it

story.body: You kept the leaf open where the king sits on the ground. You did not strike a word. Dick's hand stayed in view and off the writing.

relations.note: the line, and the hand that will not leave it

title: Kept the leaf open where the king sits on the ground

participation.context: Said it through, and stopped at the ink.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the leaves, slept at his house and not here

story.body: You repeated the agreement for yourself: whole, to the Master, not played this week. You refused the struck bill a name. You put Kemp off without writing him in or writing him out. You did not open another play.

relations.note: the leaves, slept at his house and not here

title: Said the book goes whole to the Master
